decisions.reason: The battery voltage range and AXP2101 destination are already fully represented by the candidate's message-263 MODIFY; no additional or corrected update is required.
The candidate already has a complete message-263 MODIFY defining the AXP2101 and LDO sources, OR-ing method, and operating-mode selection; the battery-to-AXP2101 path does not require another change.
The message-263 boost-current and powered-load effects are already represented, while the added battery input range and battery-to-AXP2101 path do not alter the boost-enable requirement.
The candidate already contains the complete message-263 standalone-LDO mapping; the battery-to-AXP2101 normal-operation path does not change its standalone USB-power behavior.

The conditional 5V supply and GPIO3-controlled switching for the SK6812 LEDs are already represented by the candidate's message-263 introduction; the battery-path update adds no further LED requirement change.
The 2.8–4.6V battery input range and downstream AXP2101 power path do not modify the existing overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
The source decision does not change the requirement to monitor battery temperature through the J_BAT NTC connection.
The electrical battery voltage and AXP2101 power-path mapping does not change board dimensions, orientation, connector placement, or mounting clearances.
The source decision does not alter the CHGLED connector, resistor values, component population, or charge-status indication behavior.
The battery input and AXP2101 power-path mapping has no entailed effect on the eight-layer PCB stack requirement.
The source decision does not change the requirement for TVS-based ESD protection.
The battery-to-AXP2101 power path does not modify the power-board USB-C connector's data-line or sourceability requirements.
